
Usage:   quarto dev-call pull-git-subtree [name]
Version: 99.9.9                                 

Description:

  Pull configured git subtrees.                                                                                                            
                                                                                                                                           
  This command pulls from configured subtree repositories using --squash, which creates two commits: a squash commit containing the subtree
  changes and a merge commit that integrates it into your branch.                                                                          
                                                                                                                                           
  Arguments:                                                                                                                               
    [name]  Name of subtree to pull (use 'all' or omit to pull all)                                                                        

Options:

  -h, --help  - Show this help.  

Commands:

  help  [command]  - Show this help or the help of a sub-command.
